Coming soon to the App Store

Redeem your code

  1. Open the redemption link. The App Store shows the offer and its terms.
  2. Confirm with your Apple Account.
  3. Open Block and sign in. If Pro does not appear, use Settings > Block Pro > Restore purchases.

You can also enter the code directly in the App Store under Account > Redeem Gift Card or Code.

After the free month

Apple bills Pro Yearly to your Apple Account. It renews until you cancel in your Apple Account settings, at least 24 hours before the period ends. The offer is for new subscribers. Prices shown are in U.S. dollars; local prices follow the App Store.

See what Pro includes. Read the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
